name: 冰箱净水滤芯徒手换芯款
description: 徒手换芯的冰箱净水滤芯，剖面机制、双栏对比与适配示意层层递进

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF packshot field alternating with a deep violet gradient night field #1B1330 and its secondary #2A1A45, plus one matte off-white spec panel #F5F3FA for graphic screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool high-key studio light, front key with fill card, soft contact shadows, cyan rim glints on running water, skimming sweep light only where shell texture must read
styleLock.surfaceSystem: glossy mirror floor under splash heroes, bright appliance liner #F1F3F5 inside the compartment, brushed steel counter #C6CBD2 in the kitchen, matte off-white graphic panel #F5F3FA
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one headline line plus short callout labels, every word carried as a placeholder rather than fixed copy
styleLock.iconSystem: thin uniform-line droplet, calendar and check or cross glyphs, flat single-colour #6B2FA0, no gradients, no seals, no certificate artwork
styleLock.presentationRules: cartridge upright with the twin cap nozzles at the top, retail carton placed left of the cartridge with its art blanked, identical hero angle and product scale on every screen
noDrift: no color palette or gradient changes
no inconsistent lighting between comparison panels
no readable brand marks, model codes or certification artwork
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium water-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, deep violet night field #1B1330 with secondary panel #2A1A45, locked graphic purple #6B2FA0 and cool cyan accent #4FC3F7; cool high-key studio lighting with a front key, soft fill card and soft contact shadows, cyan rim glints on running water; modern geometric sans-serif with one headline line and short callout labels; thin uniform-line droplet, calendar and check or cross glyphs only, flat and single colour; graphic screens stay clean two-dimensional infographic layouts with generous negative space; cartridge always upright with cap nozzles at the top and carton art blanked; stable product scale and placement across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no readable brand marks or model codes, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清零售盒与滤芯本体的关系，拿下第一跳点击

shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front key with a soft fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadows only
shots.props: none, only the upright retail carton whose printed faces stay blank
shots.whitespace: even margin all round the silhouette, nothing crowding the edges
shots.promptTemplate: Packshot of {product} standing beside its upright retail carton on a seamless white field #FFFFFF. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level camera, carton at the left and the cartridge upright at the right with its twin cap nozzles at the top, both silhouettes fully inside the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting from the front with a soft fill card, soft contact shadows grounding both items so nothing floats. Carton faces rendered as blank colour blocks in locked purple #6B2FA0 with empty label areas. The pair occupies 60-70% of the frame with even margin all round for search-list compliance. Negative: no wordmark or logo anywhere on the carton, no readable lettering, no QR code, no badge or seal artwork, no props, no hands, no tinted or gradient background, no floating product without a contact shadow, no cut-off edges.

Camera placed low along the channel axis at a shallow angle, macro lens, very shallow depth of field with the entry point sharp and the far end dissolving. provenance.notes: 逐图事实：1 亮白底零售挂盒与圆柱滤芯并排（滤芯顶部双插头）；2 夜紫渐变底，盒居中、左右对称水花、镜面地面、左下大字标题；3 夜紫底斜置透明爆炸剖面，端盖垫圈分离，三段引线标注分层结构；4 壳体内微距，一束水流对角穿入，发光颗粒点与左下两行大字；5 双栏对比矩阵，左右各一滤芯线框、三行勾选与叉号水滴图标；6 顶部字标加两行说明，下方五个家电厂字标横排；7 夜紫底三种冰箱形态线稿，引线连到右侧滤芯轮廓，下方机型代码清单与脚注；8 冰箱内胆中一只手把滤芯旋入顶置卡座，左下线条图标加一行说明；9 拉丝不锈钢厨房台面，冰杯与挂盒并置，棱镜彩虹光带。品类判定依据：主体是冰箱净水滤芯耗材，依附于冰箱这一大家电、随家电渠道销售，不属无电小件厨具，故改判 家用电器/大家电，leaf 记为冰箱净水滤芯耗材，并与库内净水壶滤芯模版在语义上区隔。已剥离内容：厂牌字标与系列昵称、认证机构名称与标准编号、削减污染物条目数与百分比、颗粒尺寸倍数、更换周期月数、适配家电厂字标与机型代码、二维码与脚注、双语原句与全部图内英文文案（改为 {selling_point_1}、{callout_1} 这类占位或空白证明框），滤芯本体一律以 {product} 占位。
